senses.gloss:
mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Desert.
2 Salt or barren, (soil.)
E.
see इराण.

m. (-दः)
1 A flash of lightning, or the fire attending the fall of a thunderbolt.
2 Submarine fire.
E.
इरा water, here also watery clouds, and मद what plays or shines.

f. (-रा)
1 The earth.
2 Water.
3 Speech.
4 The goddess of speech, &c.
5 Ardent spirits.
E.
इण to go, and रन् Uṇādi affix, fem. affix टाप्.

r. 2nd cl. (ईर्त्ते)
1 To go.
2 To shake.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (ईरति, ईरयति)
1 To go.
2 To throw or direct, to drive or force on;
with उत् prefixed,
to say or speak:
with प्र,
to send, to make to go;
with सम्,
to go like the wind.

m. (-रः)
Hail.
mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Earth-born, terrestrial.
2 Aquatic.
E.
इरा water, &c. and चर what goes.

m. (-जः)
A name of KANDARPA, the Hindu CUPID.
E.
इरा water, and ज born.

m. (-वान्)
1 The ocean.
2 A cloud.
3 A king.
mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Watery, having or yielding water, &c.
E.
इरा and मतुप् aff.

f. (-का)
Pimples or pustules on the head.
